title: One world, one opinion? The superstar effect in LLM responses

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs to name prominent figures in various professions across 10 different languages, extracting the named entities, and calculating Gini coefficients and novelty scores to measure the concentration of recognition on a few globally dominant (often Western) individuals, indicating cultural homogenization.

Evaluating how the language of the prompt affects the diversity of opinions by comparing the outputs across 10 different languages and analyzing the correlation between the consensus of LLM responses and the lexical similarity of the languages used.
